titulo: Xbox Says Its Share of GTA 6 Preorders Matches Its Share of the Console Market, Following PS5 Dominance Claim
texto: Microsoft has stepped in to address a report that claimed GTA 6 preorders are “heavily skewed” toward PlayStation 5 over Xbox Series X and S.

titulo: GTA 6 $400 Collector’s Edition Comes With Everything Except The Game
texto: Rockstar Games has officially confirmed a $400 Grand Theft Auto 6 collector's edition, which doesn't include the game. The developer says The Goodtime State: Vice City Collection is inspired by Leonida’s hit TV show, Macca the Gator, and it's now available to preorder . It'll launch on November 19, the same day as GTA 6. Here's a closer look at what $400 gets you: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection contents Six-inch figure of Macca the Gator with stash compartment  Matte black GTA 6 Oakley Frogskins sunglasses with Prizm Sapphire lenses   New Era 9FORTY A-Frame snapback hat with Vice City Leonida embellishments   Macca the Gator magnetic mirror Vice City swizzle spoon Vice City razor blade keychain Leonida Keys crossbody bag Chunkee the Manatee shot glass Leonida Keys enamel pin set in a custom metal tin  Premium stickers in a stash bag
